## Use case

do, what they're blocked on. Concrete > abstract — "I want to see
which peer is consuming the most relay bandwidth from the panel" beats
"add an observability feature". -->

## Proposed shape

<!-- Optional. If you have a specific idea (CLI subcommand, env var,

## What it would replace / change

<!-- The current state — usually "today I work around this by …" or
"today this isn't possible at all". This is the most useful field for
sizing the request against alternatives. -->
